newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Dean Foods buy reiterated.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Dean Foods buy reiterated.

text.p: -- Prudential Securities analyst John McMillin said Thursday he reiterated his buy rating on Dean Foods Co, which today reported stronger than expected third quarter earnings.
-- "Another positive surprise," McMillin said, commenting on the earnings.
-- Dean Foods earned $0.51 a share in the third quarter, above the First Call consensus estimate of $0.44 and up from $0.17 a year ago.
-- McMillin said Dean Foods is benefiting from lower operating costs and particular strength in some of its businesses, such as powdered coffee creamer.
-- McMillin said he kept his fiscal fourth quarter estimate of $0.67 a share, compared with $0.29 a year ago before a charge.
